source.version: Research Square preprint v1, posted February 5th, 2026; DOI 10.21203/rs.3.rs-8774138/v1 (PDF p. 1).

studies.label: Randomized two-stage narrative-writing experiment with undergraduate students

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 4, Section 2.1 (valid cases before model-specific exclusions); PDF pp. 7-9, Sections 2.5 and 3.2-3.4 (model-specific exclusions)
counts_source.quote: Following data screening for attrition and non-compliance, 112 valid cases remained, resulting in a total of 224 creative writing samples (first and final drafts combined).

arms.name: AI-first
arms.description: First draft with AI; final draft independently, with the earlier draft available for reference. The valid-case pool before model-specific exclusions contained 28 people (PDF p. 4, Section 2.1); this is not a printed final-model denominator.

arms.name: AI-follow
arms.description: First draft independently; final draft with freely chosen GenAI. The valid-case pool before model-specific exclusions contained 25 people (PDF p. 4, Section 2.1); this is not a printed final-model denominator.

arms.name: AI-parallel
arms.description: Both drafts with freely chosen GenAI. The valid-case pool before model-specific exclusions contained 30 people (PDF p. 4, Section 2.1); this is not a printed final-model denominator.

arms.name: Human-only
arms.description: Both drafts independently without AI. The valid-case pool before model-specific exclusions contained 29 people (PDF p. 4, Section 2.1); this is not a printed final-model denominator.

studies.task: Write a first and a final narrative draft on "Imagine and depict the future world" under the assigned schedule of AI availability.

ai_tool.name: Participant-selected generative AI tools, with ChatGPT and DeepSeek given as examples; assistance model versions not stated.
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 5, Section 2.2.1; PDF p. 7, Section 2.4

preregistration.where: No preregistration is stated in the complete main PDF.

estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Overall narrative-creativity score; the rule for aggregating dimensions and raters is not stated. Every narrative was independently scored by ten trained undergraduate raters, blinded to condition. The rubric uses four dimensions rated on nine-point scales, from very poor to very good. PDF pp. 5-6, Sections 2.3-2.3.1.

sources.quote: Comparison of mean creativity scores between first and final drafts across four experimental groups (Human evaluation). The four groups are: AI-first, AI-follow, AI-parallel, and Human-only.

estimates.notes: Figure-only comparison: the box plots contain no printed numerical arm means, SDs, SEs, or pairwise test or effect. All statistics remain null; no values were read from axes, points, box boundaries, or whiskers. The caption is provenance for the outcome, not numerical evidence. Both AI-first and AI-parallel used AI during this first draft (PDF pp. 6-7, Section 2.4). Section 2.5 (PDF p. 7) describes a significant omnibus first-draft ANOVA but prints neither its statistic nor a pairwise result. The valid-case arm counts precede model-specific exclusions and no sample count is printed for this figure, so analysis Ns are null. This is a between-person arm comparison, not a randomized-order crossover; within_person is null.

AI-follow group (M = 4.81, SE = 0.10).

estimates.notes: AI-follow and Human-only both produced the first draft independently before AI-follow received AI (PDF pp. 6-7, Section 2.4). The reported ANCOVA contrast is retained because its first-draft covariate precedes AI exposure in both compared arms. The common model also includes AI-first and AI-parallel, whose first drafts were AI-assisted; their adjusted contrasts are excluded separately. The model controls for first-draft score, age, gender, AI literacy, and creative personality (PDF pp. 7-8, Section 2.5). Exact model-specific analyzed totals and arm counts are not printed; the valid-case counts are not substituted and counts are not derived from exclusions or degrees of freedom. The paper does not specify the standardizer for Cohen's d. Omnibus F tests and partial eta-squared are not pairwise contrast statistics and are not entered. Printed precision is preserved in the source quotes. Arm means are adjusted means and their printed SEs are not SDs. The human-rated overall model excludes seven influential cases (PDF p. 8, Section 3.2).

open_items: The randomized design is explicit, but the paper does not identify a supervised laboratory, online-panel, or ordinary-coursework setting. design_class is null rather than guessing one of the extraction schema's RCT subtypes (PDF pp. 4-7, Methods).
The trial country is not explicitly stated. Yangzhou University affiliation and recruitment alone are not entered as a confirmed country.

Original randomized total, randomized arm counts, and initial attrition or non-compliance counts are not printed. The valid-case sample and arm counts precede model-specific exclusions (PDF p. 4, Section 2.1).

Exact analyzed totals and per-arm counts after model-specific influential-case exclusions are unreported; subdomain exclusion counts are absent. No counts are derived from degrees of freedom or subtraction. Figure-specific first-draft Ns are also unreported (PDF pp. 7-9 and 16-19).

First-draft arm statistics and numerical pairwise effects are not printed. Figures 1-4 show unlabeled box plots, and the first-draft omnibus ANOVA is described without a statistic (PDF p. 7, Section 2.5; PDF pp. 16-19).

Participant-level SDs, pairwise effect SEs/CIs, and the standardizer for the printed Cohen's d values are not supplied. Printed arm SEs are for adjusted means and cannot be treated as SDs (PDF pp. 8-9).

Section 3.4 does not identify the evaluator behind its numerical subdomain ANCOVAs, although human and AI subdomain figures are separate. Numerical subdomain measures remain null (PDF p. 9; PDF pp. 18-19).
The construction of overall narrative creativity across the rubric dimensions and human raters is not specified (PDF pp. 5-6).

The AI-follow contrast is retained because first-draft scores precede AI exposure in both compared arms. The common fitted ANCOVA nevertheless includes the two arms with already AI-assisted first drafts. An unadjusted or separately fitted pre-AI-adjusted AI-follow contrast is not printed (PDF pp. 6-9).
Numerical unadjusted final-draft comparisons are absent. AI-first and AI-parallel adjusted comparisons are excluded because their first-draft covariate is post-AI (PDF pp. 6-9; Figures 1-4).
Participant-selected assistance models and their release years are not identified. DeepSeek-V3 is the evaluator, not a uniform assistance model (PDF pp. 5-7).

notes: Extractor A independently read the entire markdown conversion from start to end, including references, all figure captions, and the supplementary-file list. Every cited main-PDF page was checked with PyMuPDF; Figures 1-4 were also inspected visually in memory, without creating image files. The screening form and citation record were used as maps, not as substitutes for the PDF. All numerical statistics in estimates are transcribed from the PDF; no totals, SDs, differences, standardized effects, or uncertainties were computed. Source quotations normalize PDF whitespace only and retain printed precision. Null-only first-draft records preserve the screening form's reported graphical comparisons and their separate human/AI scoring variants. The study-level and arm analyzed counts are null because the printed valid-case pool is not the model-specific final analysis sample. The strict post-treatment-adjustment exclusion is applied to AI-first and AI-parallel final-draft contrasts; the AI-follow comparison uses first-draft scores collected before AI exposure in both compared arms. There are no printed full-sample pairwise AI-configuration contrasts to transcribe, no reported across-person diversity outcome, and no delayed participant outcome. Flexibility is within-narrative category variety. Shared sample and preregistration are not stated. Unknown RCT subtype, country, and tool year remain null. Only the requested extraction file is written.
